usage: unfurl [-h] [-d] [-f FILTER] [-l] [-o OUTPUT] [-t {tree,json}] [-v]
              what_to_unfurl

unfurl takes a URL and expands ("unfurls") it into a directed graph,
extracting every bit of information from the URL and exposing the obscured.

positional arguments:
  what_to_unfurl        what to unfurl. typically this is a URL, but it also
                        supports integers (timestamps), encoded protobufs, and
                        more. if this is instead a file path, unfurl will open
                        that file and process each line in it as a URL.
